name: Moritz Kipp
title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
description: Test automation with Playwright and TypeScript, API and security testing, and risk-based test strategy. Based in Hamburg.
summary: Quality engineer with nearly 10 years of experience in web and mobile applications. I lead test planning and risk assessment for new features, build and maintain Playwright and TypeScript end-to-end suites, and add API and security testing where it matters.

I work closely with developers, product managers and designers to define acceptance criteria and embed quality early in the development process, and I mentor new team members and fellow QA engineers. Since 2025 I have been using AI tools, including AI agents and MCPs, to speed up automation and QA workflows.

bullets: Lead test planning and risk assessment for new features, covering mobile, frontend, backend and database changes.
Design, implement and maintain end-to-end test suites with Playwright, tailored to the needs of each feature team.
Mentor new team members and fellow QA engineers: onboarding, guidance on testing strategies and best practices.
Collaborate with developers, product managers and designers to define acceptance criteria and embed quality assurance early in the development lifecycle.
Use AI tools to improve E2E test quality and take part in an internal AI initiative to improve context awareness in Playwright-based testing.

experience.summary: Worked as an IT recruiter, my first contact with the wider IT domain before moving into software quality.
